issue.title: Weekly summary arrives at 08:30 for our Bengaluru team
issue.body:
The weekly summary is meant to arrive on Monday at 08:00 in each person's own
time zone. Our London and Chicago offices get it at 08:00 sharp, but the eleven
people in Bengaluru get it at 08:30 every Monday. A colleague in St. John's,
Newfoundland, also gets hers at 08:30, and our contractor in Kathmandu at 08:45.
Not a big deal, but our Monday stand-up starts at 08:15 and the numbers aren't
in yet.
## Discussion

### priya-s (maintainer) · 2026-11-03
Thanks. Can you confirm the time zone saved in one of the Bengaluru profiles?

### fin-ops-blr · 2026-11-03
`GET /users/me` shows `"timezone": "Asia/Kolkata"` for all of them. The
Newfoundland one is `America/St_Johns`.

input.title: Send the weekly rollup at 08:00 local for half-hour and 45-minute time zones
input.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

startRollupSchedule ticks only at the top of each UTC hour, and isRollupDue only checks localHour === SEND_HOUR. For zones offset by :30 or :45 (Asia/Kolkata, America/St_Johns, Asia/Kathmandu) the first tick inside local hour 8 is at 08:30 or 08:45 local, so the email is late. Proposed change: tick every 15 minutes (aligned to the quarter hour) and make isRollupDue require the local time to be within the first 15 minutes of SEND_HOUR (i.e. local hour 8 and local minute < 15), so each user is still picked up by exactly one tick, at 08:00 local. Needs a local-minute helper in src/util/dates.ts, and tests for the three zones.

Separate note: startOfWeek in src/util/dates.ts ignores tz (TODO: honour tz), which is a different bug worth its own issue.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Thanks for the detailed report; here is what triage found.

The rollup scheduler (startRollupSchedule) only ticks at the top of each UTC hour, and isRollupDue sends whenever the user's local hour is 8. Zones offset by :30 or :45 (Asia/Kolkata, America/St_Johns, Asia/Kathmandu) have no tick at local 08:00, so the first tick in their hour 8 lands at 08:30 or 08:45. A draft PR (pr-3) proposes ticking every 15 minutes and sending only in the first quarter-hour of local 08:00. Separately, startOfWeek in src/util/dates.ts ignores the time zone (a TODO), which should be tracked on its own.

In short: the rollup scheduler (startRollupSchedule) only ticks at the top of each UTC hour, and isRollupDue sends whenever the user's local hour is 8.

This triage rests on the issue as it was filed and on what RepoMind's own reads of the repository returned. If any of it looks wrong, a maintainer can change the label or close the draft pull request. Nothing has been merged.
